I or T: › [ I or T ] to make or become less severe, difficult, unpleasant, painful, etc.

T + adv/prep: › [ T + adv/prep ] to move or to make something move slowly and carefully in a particular direction or into a particular position
（使）小心緩慢地移動；（使）緩緩移動

NONE: B2 the state of experiencing no difficulty, effort, pain, etc.
容易，不費力；舒適，安逸，自在
B2 relaxed
不拘束的；放鬆的
› If someone, especially a soldier, is at ease, they are standing with their feet apart and their hands behind their back.
（士兵）稍息（姿勢）

example: To ease the problem of overcrowding, new prisons will be built.
爲了緩解監獄裡人滿爲患的情況，將修建新的監獄。
These pills should ease the pain.
這些藥丸能緩解疼痛。
After the arrival of the United Nations soldiers, tension in the area began to ease.
聯合國維和士兵到達後，這個地區的緊張局勢開始得到緩解。
She eased the key into the lock, anxious not to wake anyone.
她小心翼翼地把鎖匙插入鎖孔，生怕驚醒任何人。
I eased myself out of the chair.
我慢慢地從椅子上站起身。
She won the 400 metre race with ease.
她輕鬆贏得了400米賽跑的冠軍。
The doors are extra-wide for ease of access (= so that people can get in without difficulty).
門都是加寬的，出入方便。
He felt completely at ease.
他感到全身放鬆。

NONE: › to make someone leave a job or powerful position
把…打發走；使…離職

example: The head teacher was eased out of his job after teachers and parents accused him of being autocratic.
老師和家長都指責這位校長太獨斷專行，於是他被迫離職。

NONE: › to stop someone from worrying
使…安心；寬慰…

example: If it will ease your mind, I'll have a word with Charlotte for you.
要是你覺得這樣便能安心的話，我去跟夏綠蒂談一談。

NONE: › to gradually stop or become less
逐漸停止；減少，減輕
› to start to work less or do things with less energy
放鬆；緩和；變得悠閒
› to start to treat someone less severely
不再爲難；不再如此苛刻

example: At last the rain began to ease off.
最終雨勢開始減弱了。
As he got older, he started to ease up a little.
隨著年歲增長，他工作起來就不再那麼拼命了。
I wish his supervisor would ease up on him a bit.
我希望他的上司能對他寬厚一些。

NONE: › a wooden frame, usually with legs, that holds a picture, especially one that an artist is painting or drawing
（尤指畫家作畫用的）畫架
C1 said when something seems like a good idea but would be difficult to do
說時容易做時難；說說容易

example: "Why don't you just ask Simon to pay?" "That's easier said than done."
「你爲甚麽不讓賽門付錢？」「說得倒容易。」

NONE: A2 with no difficulty or effort
容易地；輕易地；不費力地
C2 without doubt
無疑；肯定
C1 very likely to happen or be true
很可能發生地，很可能成為現實地
› quickly, or more quickly than usual
很快地；（比正常情況）更快地

example: I can easily be home early tonight, if you want.
你想讓我回去的話，我今晚就能早早到家，完全不費力。
For me, Venice is easily the most beautiful city in Europe.
對我來說，威尼斯絕對是歐洲最美麗的城市。
Prices could easily rise further.
價格很可能會進一步上漲。
Ever since the illness I get tired very easily.
自從生了那場病之後，我動不動就感到渾身乏力。

NONE: A2 the direction from which the sun rises in the morning, opposite to the west, or the part of an area or country that is in this direction
東；東方
B2 Asia, especially its eastern and southern parts
（尤指亞洲東部和南部地區）亞洲國家，東方國家
› those countries in Europe that had communist governments before the 1990s
（20世紀90年代前的）東歐共産主義國家，東方集團
A2 in or forming the east part of something
東方的；東部的；東邊的
A2 towards the east
向東，朝東
› a wind coming from the east
東風

example: The points of the compass are north, south, east, and west.
指南針上的四個方位點是北、南、東和西。
Which way is east?
哪邊是東啊？
Most of the country, except the east, is rural.
除了東部外，這個國家大部分地區都是農村。
Her home is in the east of France.
她的家在法國東部。
According to the map, the village lies about ten kilometres to the east of here.
從地圖上看，這個村子位於距此以東約十公里的地方。
She spent her childhood in the East - mostly in China.
她在東方——主要是中國——度過了童年。
The collapse of Communism changed East-West relations for ever.
共産主義在東歐的瓦解永久性地改變了東方集團與西方集團之間的關係。
Cambridge is in East Anglia.
劍橋位於東英格蘭。
The east wall of the mosque is covered with a beautiful mosaic.
清真寺的整面東牆上是一幅漂亮的鑲嵌畫。
We'll drive east for a few more miles, then turn south.
我們再向東開幾英里，然後轉彎向南。
They were the first people to travel east of the mountains (= into the area beyond and to the east of the mountains).
他們是第一批到達此山脈以東地區的人。
We walked due (= directly) east for two kilometres.
我們向正東方向走了兩公里。
The garden faces east, so we'll get the morning sun.
花園朝東，所以上午我們可以享受到陽光。

NONE: › someone who lives in the East End of London
倫敦東區人
› a country in Southeast Asia
東帝汶
› belonging to or relating to East Timor or its people
東帝汶的；東帝汶人的
› a person from East Timor
東帝汶人
› going or leading towards the east
向東（的）；朝東（的）

example: an eastbound train
向東行駛的列車
A flight eastbound causes more severe jetlag than flying west.
向東飛行的航班比向西飛行的航班引起的時差反應更大。

NONE: › a Christian religious holiday to celebrate Jesus Christ's return to life after he was killed
復活節（基督教紀念耶穌復活的節日）

example: I get two weeks off school at Easter.
復活節我們學校放假兩周。

NONE: Easter Sunday
› chocolate in the shape of an egg, given as a present or hidden for children to find at Easter
復活節巧克力蛋
› mainly US an egg that is dyed (= coloured) and sometimes decorated, and hidden for children to find at Easter
復活節彩蛋
› the day on which Easter is celebrated
復活節星期日
› in or towards the east, or blowing from the east
向東方的；在東方的；東風的
› a wind that blows from the east
東風
› a wind that blows from the east
東風

example: They were travelling in an easterly direction.
他們當時正在向東行進。
The town is in the most easterly part of the country.
這個城鎮位於該國的最東部。

NONE: B1 in or from the east part of an area
（某個地區的）東部的；來自東部的

example: The eastern part of the country is very mountainous.
這個國家的東部地區多山。
Until about 1991, the Eastern bloc was the Soviet Union and the communist countries of eastern Europe.
直到1991年左右，東方集團是指蘇聯和東歐的共産主義國家。
Buddhism and other Eastern (= Asian) religions fascinate me.
佛教和其他東方宗教讓我著迷。

NONE: › the time on the eastern coast of the US and Canada
（美國、加拿大的）東部時間
› a person who comes from a country in Asia
東方人，亞洲人
› a person who comes from the east of a country, especially the US
（尤指美國）東部人

example: He said that Americans need to understand the East, and Easterners need to understand the West.
他說美國人需要了解東方，而亞洲人也應該了解西方。
It's a popular ski resort with easterners.
這是美國東部人偏好的一個滑雪勝地。

NONE: › furthest towards the east of an area
最東的，極東的

example: Lowestoft is the easternmost town in Great Britain.
洛斯托夫特是英國最東邊的城市。

NONE: › towards the east
向東的；朝東的
› towards the east
向東的；朝東的

example: They marched eastward towards the capital.
他們朝東向著首都前進。
The storm is moving slowly eastwards.
暴風雨正緩緩向東推進。
He was going in an eastward direction.
他向著東邊的方向走了。

NONE: A1 needing little effort
容易的；不費力的
› comfortable or calm; free from worry, pain, etc.
舒適的；安逸的；安心的

example: an easy exam
容易的考試
Would a ten o'clock appointment be easier for you?
會面定在十點是不是對你更方便一點？
[ + to infinitive ] It's easy to see why he's so popular.
不難看出他爲何會那麽受歡迎。
She's very easy to talk to.
她平易近人，跟她很容易談得來。
The easiest thing to do would be for us to take the train home.
對我們來說，最簡單的做法莫過於坐火車回家。
It isn't easy being a parent.
爲人父母，殊非易事。
Getting into the movie business is no easy matter.
要躋身電影業可不是件容易的事。
I don't trust that easy (= relaxed) charm of his.
他那副從容自如的瀟灑風度倒是讓我信不過。
informal My car can do 250 kph, easy.
我的車每小時能跑250公里，輕而易舉。
Opposite
difficult
They both retired and went off to lead an easy life in the Bahamas.
他們兩個都退休了，一起到了巴哈馬群島過安逸生活去了。
I don't feel easy about leaving him alone in the house all day.
把他一個人留在家裡一整天，我可不放心。
With the harvest finished, I was able to relax with an easy mind/conscience.
收割結束了，我可以安心地／心安理得地放鬆一下了。

NONE: › a big soft comfortable chair with arms
安樂椅
› said when something, especially money, is easily got and then soon spent or lost
（尤指錢）來得容易去得快

example: I lost £500 in a card game last night, but that's life - easy come, easy go.
昨晚我賭牌輸了500英鎊，但是人生就是這樣子——錢這東西來得容易去得也快。

NONE: › used to tell someone to do something slowly and carefully
小心些！別着急！慢慢來！
› a type of music that is not complicated, serious, or difficult
輕音樂，輕鬆悅耳的樂曲

example: [ before noun ] easy-listening classics
經典輕音樂

NONE: › money that is easily and sometimes dishonestly earned
（有時指靠不誠實手段得到的）得來容易的錢；橫財
› pleasant to look at/listen to
悅目／耳的

example: Her paintings are very easy on the eye.
她的畫賞心悅目。

NONE: › a decision or choice that is easy to make
容易的決定（或選擇）

example: We'll have to make some tough decisions - there are no easy options.
我們不得不作出一些困難的抉擇——沒有甚麼容易的選擇。

NONE: › Easy-care clothes do not need special treatment when they are washed.
（衣服在清洗時）無需特殊處理的
B1 relaxed and not easily upset or worried
不慌不忙的，悠閒的；脾氣隨和的，溫和的

example: an easy-going attitude/manner
從容悠閒的態度／舉止
a friendly, easy-going type of guy
友好、隨和的人

NONE: › very easy
簡單得很；容易極了
